get_auth_token.title: Get an auth token
get_auth_token.description: Exchange the connection's API key for the session token every other Veedea endpoint requires. Call this first, keep the returned token, and pass it as `token` to list_campaigns, list_leads and list_product_purchases.

output.description: The authentication result, including the token to pass to the other tools.

list_campaigns.title: List campaigns
list_campaigns.description: List the campaigns you created in the Veedea dashboard, a page at a time. Each campaign's id is what list_leads and list_product_purchases take as campaign_id. Needs a token from get_auth_token.

token.description: Session token returned by get_auth_token. Fetch it once and reuse it for later calls.

limit.description: How many records to return per page.

output.description: A page of the account's campaigns.

list_leads.title: List a campaign's leads
list_leads.description: List the leads captured by one of your Veedea campaigns, a page at a time. Use list_product_purchases instead for only the leads who bought a product. Needs a token from get_auth_token.

token.description: Session token returned by get_auth_token. Fetch it once and reuse it for later calls.

limit.description: How many records to return per page.

output.description: A page of the campaign's leads.

list_product_purchases.title: List a campaign's product purchases
list_product_purchases.description: List the leads who purchased a product through one of your Veedea campaigns, a page at a time. Use list_leads for every lead regardless of purchase. Needs a token from get_auth_token.

token.description: Session token returned by get_auth_token. Fetch it once and reuse it for later calls.

limit.description: How many records to return per page.

output.description: A page of leads who made a purchase through the campaign.
